name: Potassium Bromate
aliases: INS 924a, potassium bromate, bromate of potash
what_is: An oxidising flour-treatment and dough-strengthening agent identified internationally as INS 924a.
why_botia: BOTIA flags an explicit potassium bromate declaration because its regulatory treatment differs across jurisdictions. FDA information still describes specified U.S. food uses, while JECFA concluded that its use as a flour-treatment agent is not acceptable. Those regulatory positions do not tell BOTIA how much residue is present in a particular food.
can_1: Detect potassium bromate and INS 924a when they are explicitly declared.
can_2: Show that different authorities and jurisdictions can reach different regulatory positions without presenting a label hit as an exposure measurement.
cannot_1: Measure residual bromate after baking or processing.
cannot_2: Assume that flour or bread contains potassium bromate when it is not declared.
